title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild — Nintendo Switch 2 Edition brings Link's landmark open-air adventure to Nintendo Switch 2. This edition preserves the full original journey while adding a native Switch 2 release profile, upgraded presentation features, and integration with Nintendo's newer platform ecosystem. It remains the same acclaimed game structure, but tuned as a dedicated Switch 2 package rather than only a backward-compatible original release.

gameplayPillars.title: Open-air freedom on Switch 2
gameplayPillars.description: The same world-first design philosophy remains intact, but this edition is packaged as a native Nintendo Switch 2 release.

gameplayPillars.title: Improved presentation profile
gameplayPillars.description: The Switch 2 Edition is positioned around smoother play and enhanced visual presentation relative to the backward-compatible original build.

gameplayPillars.title: All core exploration systems preserved
gameplayPillars.description: Shrines, Divine Beasts, physics interactions, survival systems, and open progression remain the heart of the experience.

gameplayPillars.title: Modernized ecosystem integration
gameplayPillars.description: The Switch 2 release sits alongside Nintendo's newer edition structure and optional upgrade path for owners of the original release.

gameplayPillars.title: Expansion-ready package structure
gameplayPillars.description: The product structure cleanly supports higher package tiers in stores where standard and special or deluxe arrangements are used.

worldSummary: This is still the same iconic Hyrule full of wilderness, shrines, ruins, villages, and environmental discovery, but represented here as a native Nintendo Switch 2 edition entry.

storyChapters.title: Awaken and leave the Great Plateau
storyChapters.body: Link emerges into a ruined Hyrule and begins reclaiming his path as the kingdom's hero.

storyChapters.title: Explore and prepare freely
storyChapters.body: The freedom to decide your route, shrines, gear, and objectives remains central to the game's identity.

storyChapters.title: Assist Hyrule's peoples
storyChapters.body: Each region of the kingdom offers allies, divine threats, and self-contained stories that deepen the world.

storyChapters.title: Strengthen Link through systems mastery
storyChapters.body: Cooking, combat experimentation, rune use, and exploration all contribute to long-term progression.

storyChapters.title: Confront Calamity Ganon
storyChapters.body: Players ultimately decide when they are ready to storm Hyrule Castle and challenge the final threat.

features: Open-world Zelda exploration with enormous freedom
Enhanced presentation profile for newer hardware
Compatible with store structures that separate standard and premium variants
Carries forward the acclaimed full original adventure

faq.q: Is this the same as the original Breath of the Wild release?
faq.a: It is the same core adventure, but this entry represents the dedicated Nintendo Switch 2 Edition rather than the original Nintendo Switch release.

faq.q: Can the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition be played on Nintendo Switch 1?
faq.a: No. This entry is for the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. The original Nintendo Switch game is a separate product entry.

faq.q: Does this version include the Expansion Pass automatically?
faq.a: The existence of package tiers depends on the store structure being used. This extraction keeps separate standard and premium pricing tiers instead of assuming DLC is bundled by default.

faq.q: What are the main benefits of the Switch 2 Edition?
faq.a: The main benefits are the dedicated Switch 2 product profile, upgraded presentation targets, and alignment with Nintendo Switch 2 software ecosystem features.
The fundamental content and world structure are the same iconic Breath of the Wild adventure.
